CANONICAL_DISPOSITION_OF_THE_BRIDGE.note_on_the_suggested_wording: The suggested label BRIDGE_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE_ON_RECOVERED_SUBSTRATE is NOT adopted because it is factually wrong: the bridge WAS identified. NONMERGING_CONFIRM_02 was located exactly (edlab.substrates.scaffold.ScaffoldEngine driven by edlab.experiments.sc_mcm, SCState with 7 array fields, dt=0.1, size=64, internal toggle network a=2.0/K=0.5/D_int=0.008/tau=0.20/beta=0.6, exact cohorts sum_c C == rho). It is not executable against Route E because the state spaces are DISJOINT, not because it could not be found.

PARENT_FORENSICS.pairing_justification: The parent claim 'identical enrolled fraction proves the initial microstate was bit-identical' is a NON SEQUITUR and is RETRACTED: a scalar equality constrains neither spatial organisation nor the internal fields nor byte equality. The defensible parent status is CODE_PATH_ONLY: each arm calls the same initial_state(L, seed) which draws from np.random.default_rng(seed); a post-hoc regeneration confirmed field-by-field determinism 24/24, but NO microstate hash was recorded in the run outputs, so HASH_VERIFIED is not claimable for the parent. This mission records the hash in the rows.
PARENT_FORENSICS.PARENT_POST_STEP_RANDOMNESS: NONE (engine verified deterministic: two identical runs give an identical component digest)
PARENT_FORENSICS.PARENT_EFFECTIVE_LAWSPEC_DIFFS: 9 of 12 fields differ between BASELINE and LAW_16; dt, m_max, n_max identical
PARENT_FORENSICS.PARENT_KINETIC_INTERPRETATION: POST_HOC_LAW_DEPENDENT_KINETIC_ASSOCIATION. The LAW_16 deltas are {0:12, +16:6, +48:5, +112:1} over checkpoints spaced 16 apart, so the 'median +8 frames' is a median of INTERVAL-CENSORED checkpoint labels, not an observed 8-frame time resolution.
PARENT_FORENSICS.note_on_0_over_144: 0/144 is NOT 144 independent replications: it is 24 unique initial blocks replayed under six arms.

FRONTIER_LOCATION.rule: p_D = highest tested level where, at BOTH sizes, zero bounded survivors at H=1024 AND >=80% of admissible blocks dissolve before wrapping. p_W = lowest level strictly above p_D where, at BOTH sizes, zero bounded survivors AND >=80% wrap before dissolution.
FRONTIER_LOCATION.wrapping_is_absorbing: wrapping observed at or before frame 256 is exact for H=1024 as well: the engine is deterministic and a wrapped world is mechanically ineligible from that frame on.
FRONTIER_LOCATION.departure_from_the_suggested_grid: The suggested expectation [0.35, 0.40, 0.45] is NOT used. The authentic rows put p_W at 0.55, not 0.45, because at 0.45 the wrap-first rate is 0.75 at both sizes, below the frozen 0.80 threshold. 0.40 was never a tested level and inventing it would be an unfrozen calibration.

LAW_SELECTION.justification: most coherent parent kinetic signal: 12/24 discordant checkpoints, median checkpoint delta +8 (interval-censored), max +112; LAW_29 had 11/24 with a median of 0.

DESIGN.seed_rule: 920000 + 1000*occupancy_index + 100*size_index + k, k in 0..11 — disjoint across every cell, label DEV_LAW16_OCCUPANCY_FRONTIER_01, permanently excluded from any primary, reproduction or holdout

PAIRING_PROCEDURE: generate the full initial state once with the sweep quantile generator
hash m, n, b separately (sha256 of C-ordered bytes) with dtype, shape, contiguity and sum
deep-copy the state twice, one per arm
np.array_equal field by field BEFORE the first step (assertion)
re-hash both copies and assert equality with the source hash
record the same initial_microstate_sha256 in both arms' rows
factor_justification: the engine is deterministic (verified: two identical runs give an identical component digest), so there is no post-step stochastic innovation that could diverge between arms; the only differing input is the LawSpec.
TRACKED_COMPONENT_RULE_FROZEN_BEFORE_RUN: the largest bounded non-wrapping component, ties broken by (-area, centroid_y, centroid_x, index). Continuity is judged with the FROZEN tracker gate terms applied at cadence 16: centroid displacement <= max_centroid_displacement (3.0) and area ratio within max_area_ratio (3.0).
PRIMARY_METRIC: SAME_TRACKED_COMPONENT_DURABLY_SURVIVES_AT_H2048 — operationalised as: no wrapping at any checkpoint, never empty, track continuity never broken under the frozen gate terms, and a bounded non-wrapping component present at 2048.
primary_metric_limitation: ComponentMeasurement carries no track_id, so strict track identity is NOT directly observable from the production bridge output; the conjunction above is a declared PROXY.
residual_note: the residual thresholds 0.01/0.05/0.20 are NESTED and are not three independent replications; the residual stays secondary.

DECISION_RULES_IN_ORDER.1_LAW16_DURABLE_RESCUE_SIGNAL: same occupancy, both sizes: b_2048>=4 per size, c_2048=0 per size, T0_ADMISSIBLE>=8 per size, and the exact paired test combining both sizes gives p<=0.01

DECISION_RULES_IN_ORDER.2_LAW16_TRANSIENT_ONLY_SIGNAL: rule 1 passes at H=1024 but not at H=2048

DECISION_RULES_IN_ORDER.3_OCCUPANCY_WINDOW_NOT_LAW_SPECIFIC: both_2048>=4 per size and T0_ADMISSIBLE>=8 per size at the same level

DECISION_RULES_IN_ORDER.4_LAW16_SHIFTS_FAILURE_FRONTIER: >=4 pairs move the same way between WRAPPING_FIRST and DISSOLUTION_FIRST and <=1 moves the other way, at the same level and both sizes. A dissolution replacing a wrapping is NOT a rescue.

DECISION_RULES_IN_ORDER.5_LAW16_KINETIC_ONLY_SIGNAL: tested prospectively at p_W: per size, >=5 non-zero time-to-first-failure differences, one-sided exact sign test p<=0.05 in the direction LAW_16 > BASELINE, paired median >=16 frames

INITIAL_GATE_YIELD_INSUFFICIENT_RULE: applies if no occupancy retains >=8 admissible blocks per size
note: an increased lifetime is not survival; DEV survival at 2048 is not a confirmation.
